title: 第21章 任务三完成第22章 成功筑基
slug: 为了长生不死我带着全宗修仙
content_zh:
;;
“师父，你放心好了，我已经把这件事告诉我爹了，至于拜师的事情，他尊重我的选择。况且师父看起来这么厉害，怎么可能输给风灵珠那帮混蛋？”
花玲珑对寂月有着迷之自信。
那一手引天雷，哪个普通修士能做到？
“师父，还有我。”宁青青也跟着扯了扯衣角。
然后……
寂月就多了两个挂件。
收徒这件事轻描淡写的，好像一点难度都没有。
但是为什么她感觉心里有点慌啊？
【恭喜宿主完成任务三，奖励将在十分钟后发放。】
【任务四：你拥有了四位亲传弟子，也创建了本门功法，但你们居无定所，没有固定的修炼洞府，可怜的像个乞丐。
请宿主在半年内找到建宗场地，并以此为大本营。
任务失败：抹杀。】
狗系统真是一点都不带让人歇的。
“当务之急，先离开这里吧。”寂月想知道系统会给她什么好东西，之前系统给的都是好东西，那这奖励肯定是不会差的。
还好花玲珑是认路的，所以也找准了回城池的方向。
之前跟着她的随从就在不远处等着，见她们回来，总算是松了一口气。
“师父，除了咱们两个，还有其他弟子吗？还是说，我是大师姐？”花玲珑的性子实在是活泼，坐在马车上，嘴根本就停不下来的。
寂月已经把她们给收下了，那也没必要隐瞒什么，反正之后都是要见面一起生活的。
“你不是，在你们之前，还有两位师姐。”这么看来，她收的全是女弟子啊。

之前倒是想收那个莫离来着，但是系统不答应。
不过现在任务三都完成了，应该可以收了吧？
【不可以，亲传弟子必须得系统认可才行！】
“那要怎么样你才能认可？”
【正在检索条件……检索完毕。】
【计算得出，以莫离当前的资质，一年练气，十年练气大圆满，百年筑基。不符合系统条件，不可收为亲传弟子。】
【若莫离能在五年内筑基，此为合格。】
“好家伙，你这是要人家开火箭啊？要是洗掉四根灵根呢？”
【单系灵根符合要求，但，洗灵丹为八品丹药，宿主，你确定能炼出来？】
寂月沉默了。
还是让莫离当道童去吧，这已经不是在为难莫离了，这是在为难她啊。
洗灵丹已经是传说中的丹药了，近千年来，洗灵丹就没出现过。
不仅是失传了，还有一个原因是丹方中有一味重要的药材绝迹了。
所以也等于是说，洗灵丹已经绝版了，没有啦。
这也是为什么，单系和双系灵根这么受人追捧的理由。
现在的五行灵根想洗掉其他的灵根，还有一个办法，那就是徒手挖灵根，但是百分之九十九点九会成为一个废人。
根本没人敢尝试，这个数据也是之前一个疯狂的修士做实验验证出来的。
而那唯一成功的人，就是做实验的本人，他已经被打为邪修，人人喊打了。
对于收徒的事情，寂月倒是不执着，对于她来说，长生不死才是最终的目标。
要不是这系统找上门来，她还真不知道该怎么生存下去。

双向奔赴了属于是。
十分钟后，奖励到账了。

"Master, don't worry. I have already told my father about this. As for the apprenticeship, he respects my choice. Besides, the master looks so powerful, how could he lose to those bastards like Fenglingzhu?"
Hua Linglong is obsessed with Ji Yue and confident.
Which ordinary monk can do that to draw thunder from the sky with one hand?
"Master, and me." Ning Qingqing also tugged at the corners of her clothes.
Then...
Jiyue has two more pendants.
The matter of accepting a disciple was taken lightly, as if it was not difficult at all.
But why does she feel a little panicked?
[Congratulations to the host for completing task three. The reward will be distributed in ten minutes. 】
[Task 4: You have four direct disciples and have created your own technique, but you have no fixed place and no fixed training cave. You are pitiful like beggars.
Please ask the host to find the site for establishing the clan within half a year and use it as your base camp.
Mission failed: obliterated. 】
The dog system really doesn’t give people any rest.
"The first priority is to get out of here first." Jiyue wanted to know what good things the system would give her. The system had given her good things before, so this reward would definitely not be bad.
Fortunately, Hua Linglong knew the way, so she found the right direction back to the city.
The entourage who had followed her before was waiting not far away. Seeing them coming back, she finally breathed a sigh of relief.
"Master, besides the two of us, are there any other disciples? Or am I the senior sister?" Hua Linglong's temperament is really lively. She can't stop talking while sitting on the carriage.
Jiyue has already accepted them, so there is no need to hide anything. Anyway, they will meet and live together in the future.
"You're not. Before you, there were two senior sisters." From this point of view, she accepted all female disciples.
I wanted to take that Li Qiye in before, but the system didn't agree.
But now that task three is completed, it should be accepted, right?
[No, direct disciples must be recognized by the system! 】
"Then what will it take for you to approve it?"
[Searching for conditions...retrieval completed. 】
[Calculation shows that with Mo Li’s current qualifications, one year of Qi training, ten years of Qi training to perfection, and a hundred years of foundation building. Those who do not meet the system conditions cannot be accepted as direct disciples. 】
[If Mo Li can build the foundation within five years, this will be considered qualified. 】
"Good guy, are you asking someone to fire a rocket? What if you wash away the four spiritual roots?"
[Single-line spiritual roots meet the requirements, but the purifying elixir is an eighth-grade elixir. Host, are you sure you can refine it? 】
Jiyue was silent.
Let Mo Li be the Taoist boy. This is no longer embarrassing Mo Li, it is embarrassing her.
The Spirit-Cleaning Pill is already a legendary elixir. It has not appeared in the past thousand years.
Not only has it been lost, but another reason is that one of the important medicinal materials in the elixir has disappeared.
So it also means that the Spirit Cleansing Pill is out of print, no more.
This is also the reason why single-line and dual-line spiritual roots are so popular.
If you want to wash away the other spiritual roots of the Five Elements Spiritual Roots now, there is another way, which is to dig the spiritual roots with bare hands, but 99.9% of them will become a useless person.
No one dared to try it. This data was also verified by a crazy monk's previous experiment.
And the only person who succeeded was the experimenter himself. He had been beaten as an evil cultivator, and everyone shouted that he had been beaten.
Jiyue is not obsessed with recruiting disciples. For her, immortality is the ultimate goal.
If this system hadn't come to her door, she really wouldn't know how to survive.
Both directions went to belong to yes.
Ten minutes later, the reward arrived.
